definitions.window: PRs whose mergedAt is in [since, until) UTC; per_week values = count * 7 / window days

review_fix_commit.rule: a non-merge PR commit (parents < 2) whose subject matches scope OR whose description (subject minus type prefix) matches description
review_fix_commit.subject: first line of the full commit message (never GraphQL messageHeadline, which truncates)
review_fix_commit.share: review-fix commits / non-merge commits, over all PRs merged in the window

revert.source: git log <ref> --since --until (all commits reachable from main, not first-parent)

ci_runs.matching: workflow runs with event=pull_request, head_branch = PR head branch, created_at in [PR createdAt, PR mergedAt]
ci_runs.runs: every matched run, any conclusion (latest attempt only, as the runs API lists it)
ci_runs.verdict_runs: matched runs that concluded success or failure (excludes cancelled-by-concurrency and skipped)
ci_runs.rounds_to_pass_ci: ci_correctness_runs = correctness-review runs per PR, any conclusion (the definition behind the review-process plan's §0 figure of 2.02); ci_correctness_verdict_runs = verdict_runs only

correctness.order: inline Blocking-defects section, else heading Blocking-defects section ("none" = correct, any other content = defects-found), else first token

verdict_comments.final_per_pr: verdict of the last comment of that kind on the PR

conventions.reviewed_minutes: /^Reviewed:[ \t]*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)[ \t]*min\b/im in a PR comment by human_reviewer; last one wins
conventions.finding_marker: /^\s*<!--\s*rail:(correctness|security|deep-review)\s+sha=([0-9a-f]{7,40})\s+anchor=(\S+)\s+class=([a-z0-9-]+)\s+tag=(important|nit|pre-existing)\s*-->/i on the first comment of an inline review thread
conventions.disposition: /^Disposition:[ \t]*(fixed|wrong|intentional|didnt-matter)[ \t]*(?:—|–|--?)[ \t]*(\S.*)$/im in any reply on the finding's thread; last one wins

definitions.noise_rate: (wrong + didnt-matter) / (fixed + wrong + intentional + didnt-matter), over marker-carrying findings

matt_comments.rule: issue comments, non-empty review bodies and inline comments authored by human_reviewer, minus those matching convention_comment. UPPER BOUND: agents post with the same token, so their comments are counted too

definitions.no_data: "no data" means the convention that produces the value has not been used in the window. It is never written for a failed API call (the run fails instead) and never for a real zero
definitions.percentile: linear interpolation between closest ranks: rank = p/100 * (n-1) over ascending values (numpy default, Excel PERCENTILE.INC); median = p50
definitions.checks: required = live rules/branches/main and committed .github/rulesets/*.json targeting the default branch; declared = static read of pull_request-triggered workflow job names (matrix expanded) plus literal commit-status contexts; observed = check runs and statuses on the head commit of every PR in the window
definitions.claude_md_bytes: size of CLAUDE.md at the last first-parent commit on main before until

review_fix_subjects: fix: address security review of the audit checkpoint
fix: close the gaps the archiver security review found
fix: close the second round of archiver review findings
fix: close the review's gaps in the erasure id listing
